schema:name: Trusted Access
schema:description: Access requires verified researcher identification and agreement to responsible use terms. Balances openness with accountability through access logging.
schema:text: By requesting access to this dataset, you agree to authenticate using ORCID or institutional credentials, use the data responsibly and ethically according to FAIR² and Responsible AI principles, refrain from attempting re-identification or unauthorized linkage, permit access logging for compliance and reproducibility, cite and acknowledge the dataset and its creators, preserve metadata and provenance, and avoid redistribution outside the FAIR² or sovereign hosting environment except for aggregated or derived results.
